title: Duck Mod "Programmer Art"
description: Retextures the Duck Mod to fit with the Programmer Art texture pack
body:
# Duck Mod "Programmer Art"
This resource pack is meant to retexture the ducks from Duck Mod to fit the classic Programmer Art textures. This resource pack must be used alongside the Programmer Art texture pack.

Releases are backwards compatible, so using a newer release for an older version should be completely supported.

**Retextures:**
- Duck
- Duck Spawn Egg
- White Egg

## Notes
If any bugs are encountered, please report them directly to me on Discord at 'watchernovius'. Suggestions, improvements, and bugfixes are welcome.
